contracts.name: provider_configuration_updates
contracts.payload: No request payload; scheduling-only Result<(), ExtensionManagerError>; status JSON fields documented in plan
contracts.ordering: Construct, configure allowed directories/network/runtime/fallbacks, then start updater; failed initialization shuts down owner
contracts.ownership: One cancellable worker owned by Backend; no constructor network; atomic signed cache publication on owned data directory
contracts.cancellation: Stop flag interrupts network and condition-variable waits; join during shutdown; committed publication survives cancellation
contracts.reconnect: Offline attempts retry after 15 minutes while owner lives; completed HTTP checks use persisted 24-hour interval; active generation changes only after Backend restart
contracts.errors: Typed configuration errors; status error kind distinguishes network/authentication/invalid/revision/persistence; no downloaded keys or code trusted
